text:
jordan: FYI deploying llm-route v4 tonight at 23:00 UTC. Using feature flag route_v4_staged. Plan: 10% (global) -> 50% after 10m -> 100% after 30m. We'll pin model to v2.2.0 for the staged cohorts and enable a short fallback to v3 if latency spikes. Quiet window requested 22:50-23:40 UTC.

priya: Deploy job id db-80001 created. Can we add holdpoints at each step and require explicit ack from release-leads to advance to 50%+?

jordan: Yes, holdpoints enabled. release-leads must ack via the deploybot reaction or the /deploy ack command. No auto-advance without ack.

deploybot: job db-80001 scheduled by @jordan. Steps: set route_v4_staged=10% @23:00, hold; set route_v4_staged=50% @23:10 (requires manual ack), set route_v4_staged=100% @23:30 (requires manual ack). Health checks: p95 latency, 5xx rate, cache_miss. Auto-fallback to v3 pool for 90s on transient anomalies.

nate: SLO triggers in runbook: p95 > 300ms OR 5xx > 1% for 2m -> pause and fallback. If persistent for 6m -> full rollback. Also watch kv-cache eviction spikes.

priya: Ops, add rollback snippet here for quick access. Also include how to unpin models.

jordan: Rollback/unpin snippets below:

```bash
# emergency toggle off
redwoodctl flags set route_v4_staged 0 --note "emergency rollback"
# pause rollout
deploybot pause db-80001 --reason "pause: latency"
# unpin model from staged cohorts
redwoodctl runtime unpin --service llm-route --cohorts staged
# force route to v3 pool immediately
redwoodctl routing force-backend llm-route v3-backend --duration 120
```

ops-bot: Reminder: manual abort allowed for groups: release-leads, eng-oncall. Audit log will capture who ran the command.

nate: Two additional asks: (1) add a brief canary traffic tag so we can filter telemetry, (2) enable cost-per-token alerting for the first 15m.

jordan: Added canary tag=rv4-canary and enabled cost alerting.

priya: I'm on pager from 22:45-23:45 UTC. I'll post ack at each holdpoint after sanity checks. If I don't ack within 5m we'll keep at current hold and escalate to oncall.

deploybot: Canary starting now -> cohort 10% global. job=db-80001 step=canary-start ts=1812223334. Monitoring live.
